title: Demosaic
text: 对 Bayer 格式图像去马赛克，输入 1 路、输出 4 路；按 {Sensor alignment} 指定R,G,B pixel alignment；{Interpolation algorithm}、{Output image signal} 指定 Dimensions of output image One multidimensional、{Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools} 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型，按实例取值。

ports.name: I
ports.summary: 要去马赛克的图像 matrix

ports.name: R
ports.summary: 处理后图像的红色通道 matrix

ports.name: G
ports.summary: 处理后图像的绿色通道 matrix

ports.name: B
ports.summary: 处理后图像的蓝色通道 matrix

ports.name: Image
ports.summary: 处理后的多维图像 matrix

params.name: Sensor alignment
params.values: R,G,B pixel alignment RGGB (default) | GRBG | GBRG | BGGR

params.name: Output image signal
params.values: Dimensions of output image One multidimensional signal (default) | Separate color signals

params.name: Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools
params.values: 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型 off (default) | on
